name: theme
title: Theme
description: The mpkcn design tokens: dark and light palettes, mono and sans fonts, and the blink animation as Tailwind 4 theme variables.

name: boot-screen
title: Boot Screen
description: A tuigreet-style login screen with a typed username, password dots and optional matrix rain that plays before your page appears.

name: theme-toggle
title: Theme Toggle
description: A dark and light switch for next-themes, as a round icon button or a mono text flag, with no hydration flash.

name: reveal
title: Reveal
description: Fades and slides content in as it scrolls into view, and keeps still under reduced motion.
